analysis.title: NVIDIA Corp. Calm and Colletted
key_insights: Barclays keeps NVDA at Overweight with an unchanged $210 price target. It argues the FY28 outlook is underwritten because the near-term concern over demand is largely addressed.

NVIDIA raised FY28 revenue growth guidance to +75% Y/Y from +70% Y/Y. Barclays reads this as evidence that CEO Jensen Huang's departure does not change the revenue forecast and that China was not absorbing excess demand.
The company did not comment explicitly on China's indirect access to supply through SE Asia. Barclays expects this to stay an overhang into CY27.
The board appeared on the call and ended consideration of a return for Huang. Barclays thinks this was the right call, but says the leadership decision remains in limbo.

October quarter revenue was $115.84B against $109.33B consensus, about a $5B beat versus guidance. Non-GAAP gross margin was 74.9%, roughly 84bps above consensus, helped by more Blackwell Ultra than expected despite an initial $20B Rubin ramp.

January quarter revenue guidance is $130B (+12% Q/Q) against $125.3B consensus and assumes no data center compute revenue from China. Guided gross margin is 71.5% against 71.7% consensus, and guided opex is $10.7B against $9.99B consensus.

Management reiterated that FQ4 is the gross margin bottom at 71-72%, with FY28 margins settling at 72-73%. Rubin ramps more materially and costs are absorbed before purchase orders reprice at the start of the new fiscal year.
FY28 revenue growth is expected to come with CPU and Enterprise both more than doubling Y/Y. The FY27 tax rate guidance of 16-18% was reiterated.

Barclays lowers its January quarter revenue estimate to $133.8B from $137.9B and its EPS estimate to $2.95 from $3.12. FY27 moves to $427.5B revenue and $9.72 EPS. FY28 is essentially unchanged at $802.6B revenue and $18.79 EPS.
Barclays' FY28 EPS of $18.79 sits well above the $15.84 Bloomberg consensus shown in its table. The price target uses 11x CY27E non-GAAP EPS of $18.79.
Read-through for AVGO and MRVL: Barclays believes near-term numbers are largely baked. It sees more potential for upside at their prints given washed-out valuations.
Land, power and shell delays are now the company's top financing priority as management addresses longer-term concerns.

earnings_insights: NVDA October quarter (reported 11/17 per the Barclays note): revenue $115.84B reported vs $109.33B consensus est and $109.78B Barclays est. Company guidance had been $108.00B.
NVDA October quarter pro-forma (non-GAAP) EPS $2.68 reported vs $2.47 consensus est and $2.50 Barclays est. GAAP EPS was $2.70 reported vs $2.51 consensus est.
NVDA October quarter non-GAAP gross margin 74.9% reported vs 74.0% consensus est and guide. Non-GAAP opex $8,841M reported vs $9,045M consensus est.
NVDA October quarter data center revenue $107,644M reported vs $101,866M consensus est. Hyperscale was $60,144M vs $53,587M est, and AI Clouds, Industrial and Enterprise was $47,500M vs $48,515M est.
NVDA October quarter capex $4,422M reported vs $2,590M consensus est.

NVDA January quarter guidance: revenue $130.0B (vs $125.25B consensus est), non-GAAP gross margin 71.5% (vs 71.7% consensus est), opex $10.7B (vs $9.986B consensus est). Implied pro-forma EPS is $2.85 vs $2.75 consensus est.
Barclays new estimates: January quarter revenue $133.8B (prior $137.9B) and EPS $2.95 (prior $3.12). April quarter revenue $155.5B (prior $167.7B) and EPS $3.54 (prior $3.86).

Barclays FY27 (year ending January 2027) estimates: revenue $427.5B and EPS $9.72 (prior $9.70). FY28 estimates: revenue $802.6B and EPS $18.79 (prior $18.75). These are Barclays forecasts, not company guidance.
Management raised FY28 revenue growth guidance to +75% Y/Y from +70% Y/Y and expects gross margin to bottom in FQ4 at 71-72% before settling at 72-73% in FY28.
risk_factors: Slower ramp in GPUs for AI in the data center.
Slower recovery in the gaming market.
Leadership uncertainty after Huang's departure and a CEO search that could run long.
Land, power and shell delays that are now the company's top financing priority.
China exposure through indirect access via SE Asia.
vol_and_positioning: Barclays describes AVGO and MRVL valuations as washed out and sees more potential for upside at their upcoming prints.
geopolitical: China's indirect access to NVIDIA supply through SE Asia was not addressed explicitly by the company and remains an overhang into CY27.
The January quarter guidance assumes no data center compute revenue from China.

tension_points.bull_case: Barclays' upside case of $275 uses 13x upside CY27E non-GAAP EPS of $21.00, assuming a larger AI data center TAM, higher Networking attach and higher gross margins. The FY28 growth guide raise to +75% Y/Y supports the demand side.
tension_points.bear_case: Barclays' downside case of $120 uses 8x downside CY27E non-GAAP EPS of $15.00, assuming a correction in AI data center spending, a slower Auto ramp, pricing and share pressure and a long CEO search.
